result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured with no critical issues. One minor visual anomaly was identified.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section appears darker/more blurred than the neighboring cards (Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccolo), creating a visual inconsistency in the carousel. The background image is very dark making it harder to distinguish the restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent image brightness and styling across all restaurant cards in the carousel to provide a uniform visual experience.
